blocks.html: The data to create reservation items.

types.name: CreateReservationsStepInput
types.description: The data to create reservation items.

children.name: line_item_id
children.description: The ID of the associated line item.

children.name: inventory_item_id
children.description: The ID of the associated inventory item.

children.name: location_id
children.description: The ID of the associated location.

children.name: allow_backorder
children.description: Allow backorder of the item. If true, it won't check inventory levels before reserving it.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The user or system that created the reservation. Can be any form of identification string.

children.name: external_id
children.description: An ID associated with an external third-party system that the reservation item is connected to.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.
